bio: Are you in Friesland and dreaming of a getaway to Paris? Then make your way through the lovely streets of Grou to this delightful bistro. The nostalgic wall tiles, the marble counter and wooden stools, the French music pouring out of the speakers… This place has real character! Bistro classics are prepared in time-honoured tradition here: succulent foie gras on brioche, zesty canard à l'orange, a crispy and wonderfully fresh macaroon tart. The surprise menu transports you to those iconic bistros of the Parisian Left Bank....
